title: Lina R Probable NDE 13065
content: In 1994, I had an exploratory procedure in my throat. I was obviously under anesthesia and became aware that I was in an unbelievably, peaceful space. I felt the sense of a presence that was close by but I could not see it. I could only feel it. I had the impression that the presence was female but I am not sure. This Being radiated love, warmth and calm. It seemed that the Being also emitted Happiness into the space we were in. It was incredible! I conversed with the Being saying telepathically, 'I want to come with you.' The presence responded by saying 'No, you have to go.' This same dialogue was repeated two or three times with the presence repeating that I had to go. The feeling of wanting to go with him or her was very profound. I was so deeply disappointed that I couldn't go with them. After the very brief exchange of communication, I was awakened by one of the nurses who was frantically trying to bring me back to consciousness. I felt heavy, upset, and angry that she had disturbed me. I felt like I could have hit her as the situation I had just been in was so amazing! My experience was very brief but extraordinarily powerful. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1994 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related Other: Exploratory procedure in my throat How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Don’t know Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was no difference Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The difference was that we conversed telepathically Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Yes, very vast space but difficult to describe What emotions did you feel during the experience? Warmth, Happiness, compassion, love. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. I was told by the being I ‘had to go’ God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian-Catholic Non-practicing catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I don’t have an opinion on this question Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. Yes, there was a presence Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life. For me, nothing has changed significantly in any way since my spiritual experience. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes The experience was ineffable because I knew the being was there, but I couldn’t actually see it. I could sense it. However, it was as though the Being was controlling every millimeter of space we were in with love, warmth, peace and Happiness. It seemed that the presence was beaming all those lovely emotions out from it and filling all the space we were in with it. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. My experience was brief and easy to remember, however, as it was a good experience and very profound and spiritual I think that made it more indelible on my mind. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I sincerely hope that there is an afterlife, as it will be great to see certain people and pets again - that is my wish Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes A couple of people said it may have been my guardian angel. I think that is very possible that the Being showed up to block me from going further. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes. My knowledge did not affect my experience in any way, but I was, and still am, very interested in the paranormal What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real. I truly think that I was stopped from going further because my time on earth was not complete. To me, it felt very real: More real than a dream. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. It had such meaning and depth; it is difficult to explain At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I have wondered why I was blocked from moving on because I have had some very upsetting experiences, such as losing my partner to COVID. Perhaps, I was supposed to have these awful things happen to me to learn Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Just to say that the questions predominantly refer to NDEs but I would say that my experience was, to me, more like a spiritual experience rather than an NDE. raz20ej_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: Unseen presence felt close by; impression it might be female (not sure). Radiated "love, warmth and calm" and "emitted Happiness" into the space.

environment.environment_other_detail: An "unbelievably, peaceful space" described as a "clearly mystical or unearthly realm"; "very vast space but difficult to describe."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Exploratory procedure in my throat; under anesthesia.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel; experience centered on peaceful unearthly space, telepathic exchange with an unseen loving presence, a barrier/being preventing further passage, then awakening by nurse.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Telepathic dialogue repeated "two or three times" ('I want to come with you.' / 'No, you have to go.').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Presence was sensed but not seen; experiencer frames it as "more like a spiritual experience rather than an NDE."
